## Run Average Dataframe

```{r}

scenario_yearly_avg <- tibble(sim = c('S1','DC-PI','DC-OH'), 
       profit_MM = c(mean(profit_c0$profit), mean(profit_c1$profit), mean(profit_c01$profit) ),
       crop_yield_tonne = c(mean(crop_yield_c0$crop_yield), mean(crop_yield_c1$crop_yield), mean(crop_yield_c01$crop_yield) ),
       precip_cm = c(mean(precips_c0), mean(precips_c1), mean(precips_c1) ),
       alt_water_cap_cm = c(water_invest_c0, water_invest_c1, water_invest_c0),
       alt_elc_cap_kW = c(elc_invest_c0, elc_invest_c1, elc_invest_c0),       
       water_cm = c(mean(water_c0), mean(water_c1), mean(water_c01) ),
       elc_prod_MWh = c(mean(elc_c0), mean(elc_c1), mean(elc_c01) )  ) %>% 
  mutate(crop_yield_tonne = crop_yield_tonne * py$ha) %>%
  mutate(elc_prod_MWh = elc_prod_MWh / 1000) %>%
  mutate(profit_MM = profit_MM / 1000000)



alt_water_c0 <- py$alt_water_c0
alt_elc_c0 <- py$alt_elc_c0
objective_c0 <- scenario_yearly_avg[1,2] * 1000000



scenario_yearly_avg$sim <- ordered(scenario_yearly_avg$sim, levels = c('S1','DC-PI','DC-OH'))


scenario_yearly_avg

```

```{r}
scenario_yearly_avg <- scenario_yearly_avg %>% mutate(elc_prod_MWh = solar_prod_MWh + util_elc_MWh) %>% 
  mutate(water_cm = alt_water_cm + irrigation_cm + precip_cm)

scenario_realized_yearly_avg <- scenario_realized_yearly_avg %>% mutate(elc_prod_MWh = solar_prod_MWh + util_elc_MWh) %>% 
  mutate(water_cm = alt_water_cm + irrigation_cm + precip_cm)

scenario_yearly_avg$sim <- ordered(scenario_yearly_avg$sim, levels = c('SS','DC-DS','DMC-DS','MC-DS','WC-DS'))

scenario_realized_yearly_avg$sim <- ordered(scenario_realized_yearly_avg$sim, levels = c('SS','DC-RS','DMC-RS','MC-RS','WC-RS'))

scenario_yearly_avg
scenario_realized_yearly_avg

```

## Yearly Dataframe


```{r}
stoch_df <- tibble(Year = seq(1,25), 
                   crop_yield = crop_yield_c0 %>% group_by(year) %>% summarize(crop_yield = mean(crop_yield))  %>% select(crop_yield) %>% pull(crop_yield), 
                   alt_water = alt_water_c0 %>% group_by(year) %>% summarize(water_depth = mean(water_depth))  %>% select(water_depth) %>% pull(water_depth),
                   alt_elc = alt_elc_c0 %>% group_by(year) %>% summarize(elc_prod = mean(elc_prod)  %>% select(elc_prod) %>% pull(elc_prod)), 
                   irrigation_water = irrigation_water_c0 %>% group_by(year) %>% summarize(water_depth = mean(water_depth))  %>% select(water_depth) %>% pull(water_depth),  
                   utility_elc = utility_elc_c0 %>% group_by(year) %>% summarize(elc_prod = mean(elc_prod)) %>% select(elc_prod) %>% pull(elc_prod), 
                   total_water = water_c0 %>% group_by(year) %>% summarize(water_depth = mean(water_depth)) %>% select(water_depth) %>% pull(water_depth),   
                   total_elc = elc_c0 %>% group_by(year) %>% summarize(elc_prod = mean(elc_prod)) %>% select(elc_prod) %>% pull(elc_prod),
                   
                   precip = precips_c0_tbl %>% group_by(year) %>% summarize(precip = mean(precip)) %>% select(precip) %>% pull(precip),
                   scenario = 'Stage 1') %>% 
  mutate_if(is.numeric, funs(round(.,2)))





c1_df <- tibble(Year = seq(1,25),
                   crop_yield = crop_yield_c1 %>% group_by(year) %>% summarize(crop_yield = mean(crop_yield))  %>% select(crop_yield) %>% pull(crop_yield), 
                   alt_water = alt_water_c1 %>% group_by(year) %>% summarize(water_depth = mean(water_depth))  %>% select(water_depth) %>% pull(water_depth),
                   alt_elc = alt_elc_c1 %>% group_by(year) %>% summarize(elc_prod = mean(elc_prod)  %>% select(elc_prod) %>% pull(elc_prod)), 
                   irrigation_water = irrigation_water_c1 %>% group_by(year) %>% summarize(water_depth = mean(water_depth))  %>% select(water_depth) %>% pull(water_depth),  
                   utility_elc = utility_elc_c1 %>% group_by(year) %>% summarize(elc_prod = mean(elc_prod)) %>% select(elc_prod) %>% pull(elc_prod), 
                   total_water = water_c1 %>% group_by(year) %>% summarize(water_depth = mean(water_depth)) %>% select(water_depth) %>% pull(water_depth),   
                   total_elc = elc_c1 %>% group_by(year) %>% summarize(elc_prod = mean(elc_prod)) %>% select(elc_prod) %>% pull(elc_prod),
                   
                   precip = precips_c1_tbl %>% group_by(year) %>% summarize(precip = mean(precip)) %>% select(precip) %>% pull(precip),
                scenario = 'Dry_Climate') %>% 
  mutate_if(is.numeric, funs(round(.,2)))



c01_df <- tibble(Year = seq(1,25), 
                   crop_yield = crop_yield_c01 %>% group_by(year) %>% summarize(crop_yield = mean(crop_yield))  %>% select(crop_yield) %>% pull(crop_yield), 
                   alt_water = alt_water_c01 %>% group_by(year) %>% summarize(water_depth = mean(water_depth))  %>% select(water_depth) %>% pull(water_depth),
                   alt_elc = alt_elc_c01 %>% group_by(year) %>% summarize(elc_prod = mean(elc_prod)  %>% select(elc_prod) %>% pull(elc_prod)), 
                   irrigation_water = irrigation_water_c01 %>% group_by(year) %>% summarize(water_depth = mean(water_depth))  %>% select(water_depth) %>% pull(water_depth),  
                   utility_elc = utility_elc_c01 %>% group_by(year) %>% summarize(elc_prod = mean(elc_prod)) %>% select(elc_prod) %>% pull(elc_prod), 
                   total_water = water_c01 %>% group_by(year) %>% summarize(water_depth = mean(water_depth)) %>% select(water_depth) %>% pull(water_depth),   
                   total_elc = elc_c01 %>% group_by(year) %>% summarize(elc_prod = mean(elc_prod)) %>% select(elc_prod) %>% pull(elc_prod),
                   
                   precip = precips_c01_tbl %>% group_by(year) %>% summarize(precip = mean(precip)) %>% select(precip) %>% pull(precip),
                 scenario = 'Dry_Climate_Realized') %>% mutate_if(is.numeric, funs(round(.,2)))





stochvclimate1_df <- rbind(stoch_df,c1_df,c01_df)
